title: Ryanair, easyJet & Wizz Air cabin bag limits 2025: which backpacks actually fit — AirlineBags
text: Ryanair priority cabin bag limit: 55 x 40 x 20 cm. easyJet large cabin bag: 56 x 45 x 25 cm. Wizz Air Priority: 55 x 40 x 23 cm. Tested against the sizers: CabinZero Classic 36 (44 x 30 x 24 cm) — fits Ryanair priority with room to spare thanks to its soft, compressible build; fits easyJet and Wizz easily; the single best-known 'never gate-checked' pack among budget-airline crews. Osprey Farpoint 40 (55 x 35 x 25 cm) — exceeds Ryanair's 20 cm depth limit; on non-priority fares expect gate checks; fine on easyJet large allowance if not overstuffed. Cotopaxi Allpa 35 (51 x 33 x 25 cm) — same depth problem on Ryanair, borderline on Wizz; the stiff clamshell shell does not compress into sizers. Rule of thumb: rigid organization-heavy packs lose to soft minimal packs the moment a strict sizer appears.
